column1: # tests/rulecheck/session_corrections.tsv — THE LEDGER ROWS WITH NO 14z KEY IN `session`, KEYED (#339, 14z-214).
# The ledger is append-only and written by tools/rulecheck.py only, so its rows written before #209 made `prepare`
# require the sitting's 14z-N key are keyed here, each with its evidence: the 37 that carry `-` (2026-09-28, 2026-10-02)
# and the 233 that carry a transcript id (`record`'s old prefix; 95 of them under ids no single session claims, and 11
# under d33b9bfe that the transcript mapping gave to 14z-183 though their manifests are 14z-183b's).
# tools/session_metrics.py applies a row only to a ledger row with no 14z key, refuses one aimed at a keyed row or at
# no row, and stops on any ledger row no session claims (gate tests/test_session_metrics.sh).
# The session is the sitting that RAN the run (the ledger's own column meaning), not a session its subject checks. The
# first witness of each is its run directory's manifest.tsv (tests/rulecheck/runs/<id>/): every artifact it staged from
# a sitting's working directory (build/agentNNN/, build/rcNNN/) is from that sitting's, none from another's.
